recommendation.reason: The foundation ships with provisional styling and the maintainer asked for a five-candidate look round on a live preview; the look is the highest-leverage unresolved decision and everything else (copy, hosting) can follow it without rework.
recommendation.recommended: site-look-005: the first visual round. Five materially distinct layout and visual-language candidates rendered as deltas on the real / and /testers pages in a dev-only picker under .grilltrack/work/, shown on the live preview, judged at 375 and 1280 px in light and dark; the pick becomes design.md version 1.
